description: Turn the automatic unpaid-invoice reminder on or off for the whole shop (owner only). When on, a customer gets one friendly email reminder a set number of days (default 1) after an invoice or deposit request is sent if it is still unpaid. Mail comes from a doingwork.work address on the shop's behalf, with replies going to the owner.

delay_days.description: Days after a send before the reminder goes out. Default 1.

name: shops_setInvoiceReminders
